name: rime-manager
title: Rime Manager
description: Manage Rime schemas, candidate rules, per-app input modes, deployment, sync, and backups on macOS
author: HenryYu

commands.name: manage-rime
commands.title: Manage Rime
commands.subtitle: Rime Manager
commands.description: Access common Rime management actions and configuration files

commands.name: pin-candidates
commands.title: Pin Candidates
commands.subtitle: Rime
commands.description: Pin existing candidates for a code in any detected Rime schema

commands.name: remove-candidates
commands.title: Block or Demote Candidates
commands.subtitle: Rime
commands.description: Hide candidates completely or move intrusive candidates out of the top three

commands.name: application-modes
commands.title: Set Per-App Input Mode
commands.subtitle: Rime
commands.description: Choose installed apps and set their initial Chinese or Latin input mode

commands.name: sync-rime
commands.title: Sync Rime User Data
commands.subtitle: Rime
commands.description: Sync Rime user dictionaries and configuration files

preferences.name: rimeUserDirectory
preferences.title: Rime User Data Directory
preferences.description: Leave empty to detect the Rime user data directory automatically

preferences.name: backupDirectory
preferences.title: Backup Location
preferences.description: Leave empty to store backups under .raycast-rime-manager/backups in the user data directory

preferences.name: reloadAfterChanges
preferences.title: Deploy After Changes
preferences.description: Deploy Rime automatically after changing candidate or per-app settings
preferences.label: Automatically deploy changes
